clues: This town stands by the sea where a stream runs out to meet it. A town named Sale sits on the far bank, right across the stream.
By the sea, this town has hot, dry days in the warm months of the year. The cold months stay mild, with damp air and soft rain at times.
In 1956 this land won its freedom and stood on its own. This town was then made the chief town of the free land.
A huge tower here is the minaret of a mosque that was never finished. It has stood watch over the river shore for more than 800 years.
The men and women who lead Morocco work in this town, by the sea shore. It is the seat of rule for the whole wide land.
